Marta Lin: Auditor asked for a reproducible evidence kit for the emergency KMS rotation tied to CVE-2025-2718. Scope: prod account 123456789012, window 2025-11-28 -> 2025-12-03. Need: KMS CloudTrail events (EnableKeyRotation/DisableKeyRotation/ScheduleKeyDeletion/GenerateDataKey/Decrypt), IAM diffs for service-account deprov, pre/post key-policy snapshots, approval chain, signed attestation, and a replay_check.sh + sha256 manifest. Can someone own packaging?

Ravi Kapoor: I can pull the CloudTrail + CloudWatch KMS control-plane events. CLI Ill run: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2025-11-28T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-12-03T23:59:59Z --query Events[*].CloudTrailEvent` and produce `cloudtrail/events.json` + `cloudtrail/index.csv`.

Devon Patel: Ill export RBAC diffs from the change-store as CSV (chg_id,actor,target,pre_bindings,post_bindings,ticket). I will redact personal emails but include a `tickets/redaction_map.md` for auditor reconciliation. Ill also run an assume-role check to produce the AccessDenied CloudTrail event for `deprov-svc-role`.

Ava | EngOps: IR run id rot-20251130-99. Use this wording in the narrative: "Emergency rotation executed via infra automation; approvals recorded in ticket INC-10111; post-rotation verification performed." Ill add the runbook excerpt and approval template.

evidence-bot: snapshot job started (job id: ev-1755002460). Target s3://redwood-evidence/prod/ev-1755002460.tar.gz

Ravi Kapoor: Uploaded archive (object-lock enabled). Location: s3://redwood-evidence/prod/ev-1755002460.tar.gz. sha256: 2f9a7c4b... Manifest at manifests/sha256.txt. Included `scripts/replay_check.sh` which re-runs read-only CloudTrail lookups and validates bundle integrity.

Auditor - EY: Received. Please provide the CloudTrail eventId for the failed decrypt (so we can verify) and the approval timestamps for rot-20251130-99 (who signed & when). Also note any redactions applied.

Devon Patel: Failed decrypt eventId `c3e1d7a4-5f2b-4bcd-90ef-123456789abc` at 2025-12-01T05:47:22Z (file: cloudtrail/errors/c3e1d7a4.json). Approval metadata in ticket INC-10111: "Ravi Kapoor (SecOps)" 2025-11-30T02:11:03Z and "Marta Lin (CISO)" 2025-11-30T02:28:09Z. Redactions: internal IPs and user emails replaced; ARNs and key IDs left intact; redaction map at tickets/redaction_map.md.

Marta Lin: Thanks — Ill assemble the control matrix (artifact -> SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9 clause) and a 1-page cover letter with the signed attestation PDF. Uploading final docs now; will update thread when complete. :thumbsup:
